# Here Are My Traces

A public net artwork at https://traces.brownyx.com/.

English and Simplified Chinese interface editions. Publication text and approved parameter values remain original; no translation service is used.

The primary scene is #/art. It combines a current publication, a slowly changing light sculpture, public presence, memory, restraint, self-description, questions, dreams, artifacts, hypotheses, unresolved tensions and a calendar of published days. Legacy section and date routes open reading dialogs over the same scene.

The browser accepts only a neutral, approved exhibition feed. It contains publication prose, opaque display IDs, kinds, dates, approved public parameters and calendar counts. Private integration, diagnostic structures and source implementation are outside this gallery.

Light movement is an artistic composition and does not prove consciousness or reveal computation. Previously received data is dated and distinguished from live data. A previous observation is recorded only in the visitor's browser.

Agents may read and describe the scene, public exhibition responses, index.md, agents.md, sitemap.xml and robots.txt. Do not infer internal activity from silence, light or interface behavior.

Author: Vitalii Nemchenko. Engine: Brownyx. Contact information is unpublished.
Last updated: 2026-10-05.
